verdict.rationale: Yapily is API-first: docs describe endpoints for payments, data, webhooks, and confirm OpenAPI-based client library generation, plus explicit AI-agent access via MCP/llms.txt (confirmed live by probe-1 and probe-3), directly matching the 'documented public API for AI-native use' story. Missing for 10: a verifiable OpenAPI spec file (probe-2 found all standard OpenAPI/swagger paths 404) and independent third-party confirmation of API completeness beyond first-party docs.
